purpose: Design fixture for the Stage2 held-constant fingerprint. Lists the file surface that constitutes the original EMOS Stage2/local-execution stack for E1 paired runs. Digests are computed at run time over the resolved checkout; this fixture pins WHICH files are required equality surface versus reproducibility metadata, not their values.
example_note: Paths are relative to the EMOS checkout root (ROBOGUIDE_EMOS_ROOT). The population manifest's stage2_identity.file_digests carries the runtime-computed digests over exactly this required surface.

surface_entries.role: Shared OpenAI-compatible model wrapper used by Stage2 policies
Text-context sensors (scene description, robot resume) consumed by Stage2
Benchmark task spec (goal predicates, typed entities, solution)
Benchmark runner config chain root (max steps, measures, sampling)
Per-robot resume text consumed by Stage2 prompting

computation.algorithm: sha256 over file bytes, keyed by checkout-relative path, canonical JSON mapping path->sha256:<hex>
